summary: News examples pointed at Actors removed from the Apify Store (apify/google-news-scraper, apidojo/google-news-aggregator-scraper, kaitoeasyapi/twitter-x-data-tweet-scraper). Some Actors emit one dataset row per results page with items nested in an array (johnvc/GoogleNewsAPI: news_results); a normalize profile may now set `items: <dotted path>` and NormalizeBatch expands it so each element is its own Item. parseTime also accepts `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS MST`.
reason: Every documented news example failed with 404, and a page-shaped Actor yielded one empty Item per page, defeating --only-new dedupe, search and digest; the array path stays profile-driven because the generator cannot know an Actor's dataset shape.
